name: Action Link
description: Framework for configurable links that perform a state-changing action on the site (toggle a field, cycle options, change workflow state, add to cart), output as AJAX, reload, POST-button or confirm-form links.

suggests.computed_field: Enables the Action Link Field submodule (action links output as computed fields).
suggests.token: Adds a token browser to action-link label/message configuration.
suggests.plugin: Provides the plugin_type decorators declared in action_link.plugin_type.yml.

project_description: The Action Link module lets site admins create links which perform an action when clicked, such as toggling a node's published status, cycling an options field, incrementing a numeric or date field, changing an entity's workflow state, or adding a product to a cart. Each action link is a config entity whose logic is supplied by a State Action plugin, and whose UI behaviour is supplied by a Link Style plugin. Link styles include an AJAX link that updates in place (degrading gracefully to a page-reload link when JavaScript is off), a plain reload link, a link-styled POST button, an AJAX POST button, and a link that leads to a confirmation form. Actions can be toggles, linear/repeatable (inc/dec), or multi-directional (workflow transitions). Action links can be rendered directly in render arrays via the 'action_linkset' element, or output automatically through submodules that place them in entity links, field formatters, or computed fields. Action Link is described by its maintainer as the UX of Flag without the underlying flag storage, generalised to perform any kind of action.
